{"consolidated_memory":"DROPPED ROWS IN INGEST/PIPELINE/DEDUPE.PY — TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS

File: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py (ingest side)
Problem class: Dropped rows in the dedupe stage across both occasions
Signal: Output count below input count in both cases
Repro method (both): Run the pipeline over the overlapping day partitions

OCCASION 1 (2026-03-12):
- Trigger: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy only
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #5937, branch fix/dropped-rows-1
- Measured outcome: Memory settled at 933 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB
- Context: Same corner of ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py as earlier dropped rows work

OCCASION 2 (2026-03-19):
- Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys only
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one (timezone-awareness mismatch)
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #6691, branch fix/dropped-rows-2
- Measured outcome: Reclaimed 38 GB of blob storage
- Context: Same corner of ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py as earlier dropped rows work (context carried over)"}
